text:
morgan: Heads up — product wants two new telemetry fields: `route_origin` (sdk|console|api) and `quota_bucket` (free|paid|partner). Goal is better breakdowns in dashboards and for quota routing rules. Thinking schema change + backfill. Opinions?

sam: Add them as optional top-level envelope fields and bump `schema_version`. That keeps existing consumers working.

jess: optional fields are fine but watch indexes. If we add btree indexes on both we will blow up storage. Maybe store them in `tags` jsonb and index with a GIN?

caroline: For dashboards we could avoid immediate backfill if we derive from request logs in the ingest pipeline and populate a derived table. Less risk to main event store.

anil: Need numbers — how many rows in `console_events`? estimate cost for a full scan backfill vs incremental. Also consider write amplification if we shadow-write new format.

analytics-bot: shadow-write toggle enabled on staging for `route_origin` as of 1903456790 — sample volume ~2k/min.

morgan: Example envelope I had in mind:```{
  "schema_version": "v2",
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "route_origin": "sdk",
  "quota_bucket": "free",
  "payload": { /* existing fields */ }
}```Keeping `schema_version` makes rollbacks simpler.

sam: For backfill strategy: 1) add nullable columns, 2) deploy iterators that read historical payloads and write the new cols in batches, 3) add indexes after most rows populated. Avoid table rewrite during peak hours.

jess: +1 but add throttling and lock-retention limits. Also consider creating a materialized view `dashboard_events_v2` that compacts whatever we need for the console dashboards. That way we don't need to change long-term reports immediately.

caroline: UX note — console rollouts depend on these fields. We should have a feature-flag gate so new dashboards show only when the view has >=95% coverage. Product wants honest fallbacks in the UI.

anil: From infra: If we create a GIN index on `tags` we can query `route_origin` cheaply, but GIN indexes don't support sorting well. For dashboard aggregations we should pre-aggregate into a time-bucketed table.

sam: Another internal API consideration: ConsoleEvents ingestion API should accept both old and new payloads. Validate `route_origin` when present and map legacy sources (e.g., `mobile-sdk` -> `sdk`). Keep mapping logic in ingest service not client libs.

morgan: Any objections to a staged plan? A) Add nullable cols + schema_version B) Shadow-write v2 for 72h on staging and prod canaries C) Run a slow backfill job with 1M-row chunks overnight D) Create materialized view for dashboards and only swap dashboards after coverage check E) Add indexes post-backfill.

jess: Sounds good. Add a step F: run a sample of expensive queries against staging to check query planner for the new indexes.

caroline: I'll draft the console rollout checklist (feature flag, UI fallback text, dashboard swap window). Will coordinate with design.

anil: I'll run cost estimate and slot a maintenance window for index creation. Need owners for the backfill job.

sam: I'll write the ingest compatibility patch and a small RFC for mapping rules.

morgan: OK — action items: @caroline checklist, @anil cost + window, @sam API patch + RFC, @jess perf validation plan. Can we sync Weds 11?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window suggestion: 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC for non-peak index operations.

morgan: Weds 11 PT works for me. Thanks everyone, I'll open the RFC doc and link it here.
